coherence.rule: Every index uses one common market anchor and one common horizon start. Each component contributes its last actual published observation at or before each anchor; low-frequency series with no new release contribute 100, not a month-over-month move mislabeled as 1D/5D. The canonical definition requires the arithmetic mean of available components and specifies no minimum component threshold. Every omission is explicit and causes degraded status; no substitute series or transformation is invented.

formula: index_t = arithmetic mean of available oriented_index_t component values
